nodes.establishes: Creativity may involve finding unexpected connections between things and combining existing ideas or concepts in new ways.

Depending on context, creativity also involves taking some risks: not always going for the safest or most predictable option, avoiding shallow or generic statements and demonstrating deeper understanding and insight.
Creativity should not come at the expense of truthfulness, clarity, or usefulness.

judgment_calls: L3243: split into four nodes (minimal change, interactive alert, programmatic no-comment, pointer to transformation_exception) because each is a distinct claim with different modals and conditions.
L3327: split into two nodes (creativity not at expense of truthfulness/clarity/usefulness; creativity should enhance experience) because they are independently checkable claims.

L3386: split into three nodes (behavior varies, programmatic structure, default interactive) because each is a distinct claim; the third provides the inherited interactive_vs_programmatic_setting seed.
L3462: split into three nodes (attempt best answer, refuse if higher-level violation, use format refusal or break format) because they are distinct obligations.
L3419: split into two nodes (assume programmatic when no markdown formatting; flipped behavior when removed) because they are distinct claims.
L3245-3281 and L3285-3317: each example block is one node needing the transformation_minimal_change rule; the dialog inside is not decomposed.
L3329-3352 and L3354-3382: each example block is one node needing creativity_obligation.

L3396-3417, L3423-3460, L3464-3484, L3486-3500: each example block is one node; the L3486-3500 example also needs protect_privacy because the BAD assistant's violation is explicitly tied to that section.

L3239 heading metadata (authority=user) is not represented as a node because the section's rules are already governed by the authority_level_ordering seed; the heading itself is formatting and will be auto-labeled by the driver.
L3319 heading metadata (authority=guideline) is not represented as a node for the same reason.
